key_insight: Combining Neural Prophet with a Deep Neural Network (NP-DNN) produces more accurate, uncertainty-aware stock price forecasts by jointly modeling trend/seasonality and complex nonlinear residuals.
problem_solved: Addresses the inability of traditional statistical time-series methods to reliably forecast the probability range (prediction intervals) and capture nonlinear patterns in future stock prices.
method: Hybrid architecture: Neural Prophet handles trend, seasonality, and calendar effects while a Deep Neural Network models nonlinear residuals and interactions.
Produces probabilistic forecasts (prediction intervals) rather than only point estimates, improving uncertainty quantification for future prices.
Trained end-to-end on historical price series and optional exogenous features to minimize forecasting error and calibrate interval coverage.
impact: Provides AI/ML practitioners with a practical, uncertainty-aware forecasting model that improves predictive accuracy and risk-sensitive decisions in finance and other time-series domains.
visual_elements: Architecture diagram showing Neural Prophet block feeding residuals into a Deep Neural Network with final probabilistic output (prediction intervals).
Time-series plot: actual vs. predicted prices with shaded prediction intervals to show uncertainty calibration.
Error distribution / residuals plot comparing NP-DNN vs baseline models (e.g., ARIMA, LSTM) to highlight performance gains.
Flowchart of training & inference pipeline (data inputs, feature engineering, model components, outputs)
paper_title: Stock Market Price Prediction using Neural Prophet with Deep Neural Network
paper_authors: Navin Chhibber, Suneel Khemka, Navneet Kumar Tyagi, Rohit Tewari, Bireswar Banerjee
